modules.module_title: Identify appropriate site for preparing vermicompost

pcs.pc_description: select suitable location based on factors such as accessibility to road; availability of bio-wastes; good ventilation; etc.
ensure that the selected site is located close to dairy farms or places with high population of cattle to procure cow dung and farm wastes
verify that water resource is available in the vicinity of the vermicomposting area
ensure the availability of farm labour in the selected location
select appropriate vermicomposting method based on various factors
Identify various vermicomposting beds like plastic beds, HDPE vermi beds, permanent structures etc.,
obtain appropriate tools, accessories and construction raw materials as per the selected vermicomposting method
identify shady area in the selected site to construct the vermicompost unit as per the approved procedures
provide correct, safe and accurate instructions to workers for any construction work and follow the same where contributing to construction
select the appropriate kind of raw materials to make vermibed as per resource availability and feasibility, viz. straws, waste paper, saw dusts, corrugated cardboard, dry leaves, corn stalks, etc.
ensure that the bottom of the vermicomposting unit is covered with appropriate materials such as layer of tiles, broken bricks, coarse loamy soil, coconut husk or polythene sheet, etc.
prepare vermibed of appropriate height/level using suitable raw materials as per approved vermicomposting practices
select appropriate type of organic wastes (free from non-biodegradable materials) required to be used for making vermicomposting heap as per standard requirements
identify reliable source(s) to ensure continuous supply of food material/organic waste required as feeds for vermes/earthworm
verify that organic wastes are shredded into small pieces prior to mixing in accordance with good vermicomposting practices
ensure that the mixture is transferred into the vermicomposting unit following approved procedures or as alternating layers of shredded organic wastes and cow dung slurry in correct proportion
ensure that the layer or height of the heap is maintained as per standard quality requirements
check that the top layer of the vermicomposting unit is properly covered with soil, cow dung, leaves, straws or other crop wastes as per good vermicomposting practices
ensure that the mixture or heap is allowed to decompose in the vermibed for required length of days depending on the vermicomposting method selected
check that appropriate moisture level is maintained during the process in line with standard procedure requirements
maintain vermicomposting beds or bins, ensuring proper aeration and drainage
optimize usage of material including water in various tasks/activities/processes
segregate waste into different categories
dispose non-recyclable waste appropriately
deposit recyclable and reusable material at identified location
leave the work area in a safe condition in line with environmental health and safety

pcs.pc_description: identify reliable source for procuring earthworm species for vermicomposting considering approved vermicomposting practices while selecting earthworm species
select the correct types of earthworm to carry out composting types: eisenia fetida and eudrilus eugenae (exotic), perionyx excavates and lampito mauritii (indigenous)
ensure that the quantity of earthworms selected is appropriate and proportionate to the size of the vermibed
establish the favorable thriving conditions prior to releasing earthworms into the bed
verify that the organic wastes have undergone required state of decomposition prior to introducing the earthworms
check that the selected earthworms are uniformly released over the decomposed materials as per required quality standards
ensure that the moisture level is maintained as per standard vermicomposting practices
verify that the decomposed matter is loosened enough to allow air to pass through
ensure that the heap is properly covered with appropriate material such as leaves, barks, bamboos, dried crop wastes, etc.
protect the vermicomposting unit against adverse weather conditions, such as rains, winds, heat, etc.
ensure that the earthworms are allowed to feed on the decomposed materials for required period of time as per the standard vermicomposting procedure

modules.module_title: Prepare feed and manage vermicomposting unit

pcs.pc_description: collect required organic wastes and cow dung to make heap for vermicomposting in accordance with good vermicomposting practices
confirm that the collected raw materials are in correct ratio as per given vermicomposting requirements
verify that the cattle dung is properly dried in sunlight or allowed to cool for specified length of time prior to using it
monitor and adjust feedstock quantity and quality to maintain worm health and productivity
prepare the feed separately for transferring earthworms post harvesting
ensure that the heap is allowed to decompose for required period of time
sprinkle water over the heap in every 2-3 days to ensure that the temperature does not increase above the required level
drain the excess water from the unit through appropriately constructed channels
collect the nutrients rich excess water/vermiwash in containers for further utilization
use approved procedures to aerate the decomposed material with respect to the type of vermicomposting selected
manage temperature, humidity, and pH levels to create an optimal environment for earthworms
ensure that the vermibed is properly covered with appropriate materials such as wire mesh, gunny bag, etc. to prevent birds from picking the earthworms
comply with relevant agricultural practices to protect earthworms from some animals and insects such as red mites, ants, flatworm, centipedes, rats, etc
treat vermibed with insecticide in appropriate amount at the time of filling to prevent attacks by predators
establish favorable environmental conditions during the vermicomposting process against diseases such as 'sour crop'
leave the work area in a safe condition and in accordance with the environmental health and safety

modules.module_title: Prepare to carry out harvesting procedures

pcs.pc_description: use appropriate personal protective equipment suitable to the type of work
obtain tools and materials needed in carrying out harvesting procedures
ensure that the tools and accessories selected are undamaged and safe to use
follow the health and safety guidelines relevant to the work
identify the appropriate harvesting stage of compost on the basis of different quality parameters
ensure that organic matter is adequately decomposed and the vermicompost is free from contaminants
regularly test the nutrient profile of the vermicompost to ensure high quality
collect the top layer manually following approved procedures and in accordance with the vermicomposting method used such as tub method, container method, etc.
ensure that harvesting of the worm castings are limited to layer above the earthworm's presence
ensure that the collected vermicompost is stored in a shady dry place in line with approved procedures
feed the worms with partially decomposed organic wastes (prepared in correct ratio) to continue composting cycle relevant to the type of method selected
remove the upper layer of the stable and mature compost before harvesting the earthworms as per approved procedures
carry out harvesting of earthworms using technique appropriate to the type of vermicomposting method adopted
ensure that the vermiculture collected is segregated into cocoons, juveniles, adults, etc. as per work requirements
manage worm populations for sustainability, including breeding and expanding production capacity
ensure that approved post-harvesting procedures are followed
recycle the process by refilling the bed with partially prepared organic wastes in required quantity and ratio as per the type of vermicomposting method selected
ensure that the compost collected is sun dried and sieved to obtain good quality material
pack the compost in bags or containers made of suitable materials
store the bags or containers in cool and dry place
ensure pest control practices are followed during storing
leave the work place in an environmentally safe condition
